grammar_title: 主语从句(what / that / whether + 从句作主语;形式主语 it)
source: 外研社选择性必修三 Unit 1 Using language:主语从句。句子地道、围绕自我认同/外貌/社交媒体主题;答案唯一(干扰项为错连接词,排除其他成立项);零术语应用型填空。

points.point: what 引导的主语从句(从句内缺成分)
points.overview: 当主语从句内部缺主语或宾语时,用 what(= the thing that/which)同时充当连接词并补足缺失成分;that/whether 不能补足缺成分,which 无先行词,都不行。

points.point: that / whether 引导的主语从句(从句完整)
points.overview: 从句结构完整、陈述一个事实时用 that(只起连接、不充当成分);表示'是否'的开放/未定语义时用 whether;if 不能引导句首主语从句。

points.point: 形式主语 it · whoever / whatever 作主语
points.overview: 把主语从句(that/to do/whether)后置、句首用形式主语 it;指'任何人'用 whoever、指'任何事物'用 whatever 引导主语从句。

questions.stem: "____ makes a person beautiful is not only a pretty face."
questions.explanation: 从句 'makes a person beautiful' 缺主语,需要既作连接词又补主语的词 → what(= the thing that)。

questions.stem: "____ he said about my selfies really upset me."
questions.explanation: said 后缺宾语,用 what 补足并连接;that 引导的主语从句必须完整。

questions.stem: "____ truly matters is who you are on the inside."
questions.explanation: matters 前缺主语 → what(= the thing that)。

questions.stem: "____ I post online shows only my happiest moments."
questions.explanation: post 后缺宾语,用 what 补足。

questions.stem: "____ surprised his roommates was his calm, honest reply."
questions.explanation: surprised 前缺主语 → what。

questions.stem: "____ the editing app changed was just my appearance."
questions.explanation: changed 后缺宾语 → what。

questions.stem: "____ counts most is a kind and honest heart."
questions.explanation: counts 前缺主语 → what。

questions.stem: "____ she admires in Emma is her quiet self-confidence."
questions.explanation: admires 后缺宾语 → what。

questions.stem: "____ worried her parents was her endless photo editing."
questions.explanation: worried 前缺主语 → what。

questions.stem: "____ we show the world online is not always the truth."
questions.explanation: show 后缺宾语 → what。

questions.stem: "____ lies behind every perfect photo is real pressure."
questions.explanation: lies 前缺主语 → what。

questions.stem: "____ I really need is the courage to be myself."
questions.explanation: need 后缺宾语 → what。

questions.stem: "____ defines us most is our character, not our looks."
questions.explanation: defines 前缺主语 → what。

questions.stem: "____ young people share online can shape their self-image."
questions.explanation: share 后缺宾语 → what。

questions.stem: "____ impressed the doctor most was her healthy attitude."
questions.explanation: impressed 前缺主语 → what。

questions.stem: "____ he values most is being true to himself."
questions.explanation: values 后缺宾语 → what。

questions.stem: "____ happened after the makeover changed his whole view."
questions.explanation: happened 前缺主语 → what。

questions.stem: "____ the speaker described was a simple but clever experiment."
questions.explanation: described 后缺宾语 → what。

questions.stem: "____ keeps her confident is her inner strength, not her makeup."
questions.explanation: keeps 前缺主语 → what。

questions.stem: "____ I want others to see is the real me."
questions.explanation: see 后缺宾语 → what。

questions.stem: "____ inner beauty matters is something we all should remember."
questions.explanation: 从句完整、陈述事实 → that;无缺成分故非 what,语义肯定故非 whether/if。

questions.stem: "____ she edits every single photo clearly worries her father."
questions.explanation: 从句完整、是既成事实 → that。

questions.stem: "____ good health makes us happier is now widely accepted."
questions.explanation: 陈述被普遍接受的事实 → that。

questions.stem: "____ Anthony completely changed his style amazed his roommates."
questions.explanation: 从句完整、是已发生的事 → that。

questions.stem: "____ true beauty comes from within is the writer's main point."
questions.explanation: 陈述一个观点(事实)→ that。

questions.stem: "____ Emma feels proud of her body inspires many readers."
questions.explanation: 从句完整、陈述事实 → that。

questions.stem: "____ a positive image can boost confidence is certainly true."
questions.explanation: 谓语 is certainly true 指向事实 → that。

questions.stem: "____ the model stayed confident encouraged thousands of girls."
questions.explanation: 从句完整、是事实 → that。

questions.stem: "____ kindness shapes real beauty is a lesson worth learning."
questions.explanation: 陈述事实 → that。

questions.stem: "____ he finally accepted himself made his whole family glad."
questions.explanation: 从句完整、已发生 → that。

questions.stem: "____ external beauty really matters is still debated by many."
questions.explanation: 谓语 is still debated 表'是否'的争论 → whether;if 不能引导句首主语从句。

questions.stem: "____ she should delete the selfie app is a hard choice for Jade."
questions.explanation: 表'是否要删'的两难 → whether。

questions.stem: "____ looks truly affect first impressions is worth discussing."
questions.explanation: 谓语 is worth discussing 暗含未定 → whether。

questions.stem: "____ we should change our appearance depends on our reasons."
questions.explanation: depends on 表条件性、未定 → whether。

questions.stem: "____ his makeover was really a good idea is not yet clear."
questions.explanation: is not yet clear 表未定 → whether。

questions.stem: "____ beauty lies inside or outside has long been argued about."
questions.explanation: '…inside or outside' 的两可 → whether。

questions.stem: "____ to edit her photos or leave them alone troubled Jade daily."
questions.explanation: 只有 whether 能接动词不定式作主语;if 不可。

questions.stem: "____ people can ever fully accept their looks remains uncertain."
questions.explanation: remains uncertain 表未定 → whether。

questions.stem: "____ social media helps or harms teenagers is widely discussed."
questions.explanation: 'helps or harms' 两可 → whether。

questions.stem: "____ she would dare to join the show was still in doubt."
questions.explanation: was still in doubt 表未定 → whether。

questions.stem: "____ is important that we accept who we really are."
questions.explanation: 真正主语是后置的 that 从句,句首用形式主语 → It。

questions.stem: "____ is true that outer beauty often fades with time."
questions.explanation: 形式主语 It 指代后面的 that 从句。

questions.stem: "____ is no surprise that confidence makes people shine."
questions.explanation: It is no surprise that…,形式主语 It。

questions.stem: "____ takes real courage to post a photo without any editing."
questions.explanation: 真正主语是后面的不定式,形式主语用 It。

questions.stem: "____ is up to you whether you change your look or not."
questions.explanation: 形式主语 It 指代后置的 whether 从句。

questions.stem: "____ feels wonderful to be at ease with your own body."
questions.explanation: 后置不定式作真正主语,形式主语 It。

questions.stem: "____ is clear that good health is a kind of beauty."
questions.explanation: It is clear that…,形式主语 It。

questions.stem: "____ is hard to ignore the pressure from social media."
questions.explanation: 后置不定式作真正主语,形式主语 It。

questions.stem: "____ is worth remembering that kindness shapes true beauty."
questions.explanation: It is worth remembering that…,形式主语 It。

questions.stem: "____ was foolish of him to judge people only by their looks."
questions.explanation: It was foolish of sb to do,形式主语 It。

questions.stem: "____ stands behind the camera controls the final image."
questions.explanation: 指'任何站在相机后的人'、从句缺主语 → Whoever。

questions.stem: "____ accepts herself first will gain real confidence."
questions.explanation: herself 指人、从句缺主语 → Whoever。

questions.stem: "____ truly loves you cares about your heart, not your face."
questions.explanation: 指'任何爱你的人'、缺主语 → Whoever。

questions.stem: "____ praises only your looks may not be a true friend."
questions.explanation: 指人、缺主语 → Whoever。

questions.stem: "____ stands before the mirror sees only one side of beauty."
questions.explanation: 指'任何照镜子的人'、缺主语 → Whoever。

questions.stem: "____ you post online may stay there forever."
questions.explanation: 指'任何你发的东西'、post 后缺宾语 → Whatever。

questions.stem: "____ the camera shows is only a small part of the truth."
questions.explanation: 指'相机所显示的任何事物'、shows 后缺宾语 → Whatever。

questions.stem: "____ he says about my pictures cannot change how I feel."
questions.explanation: 指'他说的任何话'、says 后缺宾语 → Whatever。

questions.stem: "____ makes you feel confident is surely worth keeping."
questions.explanation: 指'任何让你自信的事物'、缺主语 → Whatever。

questions.stem: "____ they print in those magazines is not always real."
questions.explanation: 指'他们印出的任何东西'、print 后缺宾语 → Whatever。
